thi-ap30:1.2: sakyasambhavā → sakyasamhavā (bj) | sakyasambhavā yasodharāpamukhāni → sākiyasambhavā yasodharīpamukhāni (sya-all)
thi-ap30:4.3: aparādhamajānantī → aparādhaṁ pajānanti (sya-all, pts) | aparādhamajānantī → aparādhaṁ pajānanti (bj: PTS)
thi-ap30:6.4: pajāpati thīnaṁ → pajāpatī thinaṁ (bj) | agārasmiṁ pajāpati → agāramhi pajāpatī (pts)
thi-ap30:9.3: yasodharāsahassāni → yasodharī sahassāni (sya-all); yasovatī sahassāni (pts) | yasodharā → yasovatī (bj: sī, PTS)
thi-ap30:11.4: mahāiddhīpi → mahāiddhipi (bj) | mahāiddhīpi dassayuṁ cakkavāḷasamaṁ → mahāiddhiṁ vidassayuṁ cakkavālaṁ samaṁ (pts)
thi-ap30:13.1: piñchaṁ → piñjaṁ (bj) | piñchaṁ nānāsākhā → piñjaṁ nānāsakhā (pts)
thi-ap30:13.3: candañca sūriyañcakkhi → candasūravisālakkhā (bj) | sūriyañcakkhi → suriyañcakkhī (sya-all) | candasūravisālakkhā → candaṁ ca suriyaṁ vakkhī (bj: machasaṁ, PTS)
thi-ap30:14.3: bījamānā upāgantvā vandantī → vījamānā upagantvā vandanti (bj) | bījamānā → vījamānā (sya-all); vījamānaṁ (pts)
thi-ap30:15.3: candañca sūriyaṁ → canda ca suriyaṁ (bj) | sūriyaṁ → suriyaṁ (sya-all)
thi-ap30:16.3: cirapabhāvena nipphannā → vīra pabhāvane nipphantā (bj) | cirapabhāvena nipphannā naranāyaka → vīra ppabhāvena nippannā naranāyakā (pts)
thi-ap30:18.1: pubbenivāsaṁ jānāmi → pubbe nivāsaṁ jānāma (bj) | jānāmi → jānāma (cck) | jānāmi dibbacakkhu → jānāma dibbacakkhuṁ (sya-all, pts)
thi-ap30:20.3: amhaṁ → amhe (sya-all) | amhaṁ tuyhatthāya → amhe tuyh atthāya (pts)
thi-ap30:22.2: vārayimha → vārayimaha (bj) | vārayimha anācaraṁ tuyhatthāya → pācayimha anāvaraṁ tuyh atthāya (pts)
thi-ap30:22.4: cattāni jīvitāni → sañcattaṁ jīvitampi (sya-all) | no → sañcattaṁ jīvitampi no (cck: syā.)
thi-ap30:28.4: pariccattā → khettaṁ puttaṁ ca dhītaṁ ca pariccattaṁ (bj: PTS)
thi-ap30:29.1: hatthī → hatthi (bj) | hatthī assā gavā cāpi → hatthiassaṁ gavañcāpi (sya-all) | cāpi → hatthiassaṁgavaṁ cāpi (bj: PTS)
thi-ap30:29.4: pariccattaṁ asaṅkhiyaṁ → pariccattā asaṅkhiyā (bj); paricattaṁ asaṅkhayaṁ (sya-all) | asaṅkhiyā → pariccattaṁ asaṁkhiyaṁ (bj: PTS)
thi-ap30:31.4: asaṅkhiyaṁ sukhappattānumodāma → asaṅkhayaṁ sukhaṁ pattānumodāma (sya-all) | anubhuttaṁ → pariccattaṁ (pts)
thi-ap30:32.1: sukhappattānumodāma → sukhappattā na modāma (bj); sukhaṁ patvā na modāma (pts) | modāma → numodāma (bj: machasaṁ)
thi-ap30:35.1: adhikāraṁ bahuṁ amhe tuyhatthāya → adhikārā bahū amhaṁ tuyhatthā (bj) | bahuṁ amhe → bahu amhaṁ (sya-all) | amhaṁ → adhikāraṁ bahuṁ amhe (bj: PTS)
thi-ap30:35.2: mahāmune gavesato buddhadhamme mayaṁ → mahāmuni gavesantā buddhadhammaṁ mayan (pts)
thi-ap30:38.4: āyato → āyataṁ (bj) | āyataṁ → āyato (bj: machasaṁ, PTS)
thi-ap30:40.4: isimuggatamānasaṁ → isīmuggatamānasaṁ (bj) | isimuggatamānasaṁ calatī ravatī → isim uggatamānasaṁ calati ravati (pts)
thi-ap30:41.1: ravatī puthavī → ravati paṭhavī (bj) | calatī ravatī puthavī → calati ravati paṭhavī (sya-all)
thi-ap30:41.3: pakittente → pakittento (sya-all) | pakittente isimuggatamānasaṁ → pakittento isim uggatamānasaṁ (pts)
thi-ap30:41.4: isimuggatamānasaṁ → isinuggatamānaso (bj) | isinuggatamānaso → isimuggata mānasaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, PTS)
thi-ap30:44.3: vācamanumodentā → vācamanumodantī (bj, sya-all) | taṁ vācamanumodentā evaṅkārī → vācaṁ anumodantā evakārī (pts)
thi-ap30:45.2: tassa → tattha (bj, sya-all, pts) | pasādayuṁ devamānusikaṁ yoniṁ → pasādiya devamānusakaṁ yoni (bj) | pasādiya → pasādayuṁ (bj: sīmu)
thi-ap30:46.3: pacchime bhave → pacchimabhave (bj) | bhave sampatte → bhavasampatte (sya-all) | bhave sampatte jātāmha → bhavasampatte ajātā (pts)
thi-ap30:47.4: abhisakkatā → atisakkatā (bj, pts) | abhisakkatā lābhaṁ silokaṁ sakkāraṁ → atisakkatā lābhasilokasakkāraṁ (sya-all)
thi-ap30:49.3: vīra upakārañca → vīro upakāraṁ ca (bj) | vīra → tāsaṁ (sya-all) | vīra → tāsaṁ (cck: syā.)
thi-ap30:54.1: amhaṁ → mayhaṁ (sya-all) | amhaṁ → mayhaṁ (cck: syā.); amhākaṁ (cck: ka.)
thi-ap30:58.3: sahāyasampadā honti nibbānapadamasaṅkhataṁ → pabhāyasampadā bhonti nibbānamatasaṅkhataṁ (pts)
thi-ap30:59.3: sabbakammampi → sabbaṁ kammampi (bj); saccaṁ kammam pi (pts)
thi-ap30:59.4: cakkhuma → cakkhumā (sya-all) | vandāma cakkhuma → vandāmi cakkhumā (pts)
thi-ap30:60.2: uttari santasaṅkhatadosañhi → uttariṁ santasaṅkhatadosaṁ hi (bj); uttariṁ sattasaṅkhatadāso yo (sya-all)
thi-ap30:60.4: amataṁ padaṁ → amataṁpadanti (sya-all) | pappotha → santasaṅkhatadoso yo, pajjotaṁ (cck: syā. pī. ka.)
thi-ap30:66.4: cha → aṭṭhasattatimeva (sya-all, pts) | sattatimeva ca → 31yasavatīpamukhāni khattiyakaññā bhikkhuniyo aṭṭhārasasahassāni (pts) | ca → aṭṭhasattatimeva ca (cck: syā.)
